title: Compile logical Fourfold retrieval onto BM25 and typed relation indices
primary_claim: The Fourfold/Tensor layer should express typed multi-relation query semantics and compile onto ordinary physical indices; BM25 supplies lexical seeds rather than being replaced by a flattened tensor score.

design.physical_layer: deterministic forward/reverse adjacency indices over TypedRelationBlock
design.seed_layer: existing pure-stdlib s07 BM25 plus exact identity token matches

acceptance: compiler refuses a FourfoldSnapshot whose source_forest_sha256 differs
compiler preserves multiple targets for one source without dictionary overwrite
every block binds repository, revision, Forest digest and Fourfold digest
logical multi-hop intersection returns only targets reached by every branch
physical planner names adjacency lookup, sparse hash join and set combination
evidence digests survive every relation hop and appear in result receipts
BM25 supplies start-plane seeds and direct target-plane candidates
graph expansion can rerank a structurally supported target above a lexical decoy
all outputs remain proposal-only and cannot promote or mutate authority

verification.author_side_smoke: API-compatible local stubs: py_compile succeeded; focused tests 5 passed. This is not exact-head repository evidence.

kill_or_redesign: hybrid does not improve evidence recall or agent task success over BM25 plus four indices
gain disappears when graph paths are permuted or evidence is removed
gain is explained entirely by more retrieved context
construction or update cost has no repeated-query break-even
a simpler deterministic relation-index query produces equivalent outputs and costs
rollback: Delete the isolated experiment package, focused test and this Work Packet; no production contract or persistent state is changed.
